name: HFS (HTTP File Server)
description: Share files from one folder you choose through a web page, with accounts, upload permissions and an admin panel (HFS 3).

inputs.label: Folder to share
inputs.help: Only this folder is available to HFS (under /shares). Choose a dedicated folder, never a whole drive.

inputs.label: Administrator (admin) password
inputs.help: Used only when HFS creates its configuration on first start.

security: Nothing is shared until you add the folder to the virtual file system in the admin panel (/~/admin) and set permissions.
Self-update inside the container is disabled; updates come from the catalog.

notes: Public share links and WebDAV clients need direct access: a sign-in gate blocks them. Protect only /~/admin if you publish it.

limitations: Folders on Windows drives are read through Docker Desktop file sharing (slower than local disks).
manualSetup: Open /~/admin, sign in as admin and add /shares (or a subfolder) to the shared files with the permissions you want.

update.notes: Configuration and accounts live in the data volume; updates change only the image.

testStatus.notes: Manifest, Compose file set and route validated; not yet installed on a disposable deployment.
